description: Molecular Adverse Outcome Pathway for [AOP 8](https://identifiers.org/aop/8), "Upregulation of Thyroid Hormone Catabolism via Activation of Hepatic Nuclear Receptors, and Subsequent Adverse Neurodevelopmental Outcomes in Mammals". Key Event nodes and the relationships between them are from AOP-Wiki RDF 97191db (2026-08-01); the green pathway nodes are the molecular pathways mapped to each Key Event and approved in the molAOP Builder (snapshot 2026-08-13). The source AOP was developed in a non-human species; the mapped molecular pathways are human.
title: Thyroid hormone catabolism via hepatic nuclear receptors leading to neurodevelopmental defects
